messages:
olivia: Quick ask — I need a saved logsearch for /api/embeddings calls to model \"embed-lite\" in ap-southeast-1. Want to scope by org, route, model, and only show auth failures + 5xx. Also would like it added to the SRE Inference dashboard. Anyone have the canonical query and naming conv?

ben: Use the Logsearch frontend or API. Quick query I drop in the UI: 
```
service:inference AND region:ap-southeast-1 AND route:\"/api/embeddings\" AND model:\"embed-lite\" AND (status:401 OR status:403 OR status:[500 TO 599] OR message:\"auth failed\")
```

rachel: If you want org-scoped add `org_id:acme-aus` (or the relevant org). Example: 
```
org_id:acme-aus AND service:inference AND region:ap-southeast-1 AND route:\"/api/embeddings\" AND model:\"embed-lite\" AND (status:401 OR status:403 OR status:[500 TO 599])
```
Suggested saved search name: `sre/ap/embed-lite/auth-5xx` — keep it under `sre/` so dashboards auto-pick.

ton y: If you want to create it programmatically: 
```
curl -X POST \"https://logsearch.internal.redwood.io/api/saved_searches\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $LOGSEARCH_API_TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"name":"sre/ap/embed-lite/auth-5xx","query":"org_id:acme-aus AND service:inference AND region:ap-southeast-1 AND route:\\"/api/embeddings\\" AND model:\\"embed-lite\\" AND (status:401 OR status:403 OR status:[500 TO 599])","visibility":"team:eng-sre"}'
```

ben: One extra tip: if you get noisy 502s from the LB, scope to `status!=502` or use `status=~\"5[1-9]\"` to exclude LB 502 if we already have separate LB alerts.

rachel: Prometheus alert example (adjust metric names/labels to match our infra): 
```
- alert: EmbedLite_High_AuthOr5xx_ap_southeast_1
  expr: >-
    sum(rate(inference_requests_total{region=\"ap-southeast-1\",model=\"embed-lite\",route=\"/api/embeddings\",status=~\"(401|403|5..)\"}[5m]))
    /
    sum(rate(inference_requests_total{region=\"ap-southeast-1\",model=\"embed-lite\",route=\"/api/embeddings\"}[5m])) > 0.005
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: \"High auth failures or 5xx for embed-lite /api/embeddings (ap-southeast-1)\"
```

ops-bot: Saved search `sre/ap/embed-lite/auth-5xx` created and shared to team `eng-sre` by rachel at 1769993278. :white_check_mark:

rachel: I added the saved search to the Grafana SRE -> Inference -> AP dashboard under model=embed-lite, route=/api/embeddings. Left a note in the dashboard and linked the saved search.

olivia: Thanks — can you drop the grafana link when it's live? Also, please exclude 502 per ben's note for now.

rachel: Link: https://grafana.internal.redwood.io/d/inference/sre-inference-ap?orgId=1&var-model=embed-lite&view=embeddings — saved search is linked and alert rule draft is in the alerts repo, pinged @tony to review thresholds.

olivia: Perfect, that's all I needed. Will open a follow-up if the alert fires unexpectedly. :pray:
